messages:
Tanya: Quick check — I'm running a batch-gating probe against the new continuous-batching gate logic. Can someone sanity-check the run config?
Sanjay: gimme 10, pinging the perf harness.
Tanya: config I'm using: `--max-batch-size=64 --queue-ms=6 --max-tokens=1024 --gate-threshold=0.7`
Marie: are you disabling prefix/KV cache for this? we should isolate batching impact.
Tanya: yep, cache disabled for this experiment.
PerfBot: Started job 3141592653 on prod-sim cluster. logs: https://ci.redwood.test/runs/3141592653 
Jonathan: can you paste the exact bench command so I can repro locally?
Tanya: sure — command:
```bash
./bench/run_throughput --model rwd-llama-13b-q4 --concurrency 8 --seq 512 \
  --max-batch 64 --queue-ms 6 --gate 0.7 --samples 500
```
Sanjay: running that now locally, will post numbers in ~8m.
PerfBot: quick sample output from stage: mean p99 latency=142ms, avg token/sec=27.3, max batch observed=64
Marie: p99 looks up vs our baseline (~120ms). do you have the queuing distribution?
Tanya: pulled a quick histogram from logs: 0-2ms=62%, 2-10ms=20%, 10-100ms=12%, >100ms=6% (tail driven by a handful of long sequences)
Sanjay: that tail could be from sequences hitting the gate and waiting for aggregations. try lowering gate to 0.6 and re-run?
Tanya: will try gate=0.6 + enable `--dynamic-window=on` and run both variants.
Jonathan: if gate=0.6 brings p99 back under 130ms we can propose a canary with gradual rollout.
Tanya: running both now, will post diffs when complete. tagging @Marie to eyeball for quality regressions :eyes:
Marie: will monitor, thanks. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Reminder — this probe is on a prod-sim slice and will not affect live traffic; scheduled window ends in 30m.
Tanya: thanks everyone — I'll update this thread with the final numbers and the delta table in ~12m.
